title: The Specification

scenario.en: A technician needs the tolerances from a document he cannot access, and getting one number wrong ruins the batch.
scenario.ar: فني محتاج المقاسات من مستند مش قادر يوصل له، وأي رقم غلط يفسد الدفعة.

source: Specification: 'The seals, most of which are supplied pre-cut, must be seated at a torque of between 18 and 22 newton metres, the upper limit beyond which deformation occurs. The curing period, the length of which depends on ambient humidity, is a minimum of six hours and must not be shortened. Batches in which any seal has been re-seated more than twice are to be rejected. The threshold at which the adhesive fails is 65 degrees.'

task.en: Relay the four figures precisely, and say which one has no tolerance at all.
task.ar: انقل الأرقام الأربعة بدقة وقول أنهي واحد مفيهوش أي تهاون.

key_points.en: Torque must be between 18 and 22 newton metres.
key_points.ar: ربط العزم لازم بين 18 و22 نيوتن متر.

key_points.en: Curing is a minimum of six hours and must not be shortened.
key_points.ar: فترة المعالجة ست ساعات كحد أدنى وميصحّ تتقصّر.

key_points.en: Reject any batch where a seal was re-seated more than twice.
key_points.ar: ارفض أي دفعة فيها جلدة اترجّعت أكتر من مرتين.

model_answer.en: Four numbers. Torque is between 18 and 22 newton metres, and 22 is the limit beyond which deformation occurs. Curing is a minimum of six hours and must not be shortened -- that is the one with no tolerance. Reject any batch in which a seal has been re-seated more than twice. And the adhesive fails at 65 degrees.
model_answer.ar: أربعة أرقام. العزم بين 18 و22 نيوتن متر، و22 هو الحد اللي بعده يحصل تشوّه. المعالجة ست ساعات كحد أدنى وميصحّ تتقصّر — دي اللي مفيهاش تهاون. ارفض أي دفعة فيها جلدة اترجّعت أكتر من مرتين. واللاصق بيفشل عند 65 درجة.

signal_phrases.en: Am I right in thinking that?
